analytic.boundProof: Grade ramps use monotone S(u)=10u^3-15u^4+6u^5 on [0,1]; grade extrema are endpoints. S-prime reaches 1.875 at u=0.5. Exact join height and first three height derivatives are checked.

vertical.scope: Vertical derivatives only. Existing horizontal polyline corners are intentionally unchanged.
